secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Hosted Supabase project URL (Supabase Dashboard -> Project Settings -> API). Without it the app still runs: auth and saved lists fall back to browser localStorage.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Supabase publishable (or legacy anon) key, from the same Project Settings -> API page. Only used when NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL is set.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Supabase service_role secret, used server-side by the Streamtape mapping endpoints.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TMDB_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. TMDB API key (https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api). The app ships with a working built-in key; supply your own if it gets rate-limited.

secrets.name: STREAMTAPE_LOGIN
secrets.description: Optional. Streamtape API login (https://streamtape.com/accapi), needed only for the /api/streamtape download endpoints.

secrets.name: STREAMTAPE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Streamtape API key from the same page.

secrets.name: STREAMTAPE_ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Any long random string you choose; it is the bearer token for creating /api/streamtape/mappings records.
